newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern still seeks Conrail.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern still seeks Conrail.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said it is still seeking to acquire Conrail Inc and is studying the revised merger pact earlier announced by Conrail and CSX Corp.

"There should be no doubt that Norfolk Southern remains as determined as ever to acquire Conrail and will use any and all appropriate financial means to accomplish that objective," Norfolk Southern said in a statement.
Norfolk Southern also said the revised merger pact "appears to be an 11th-hour attempt to avoid defeat at the shareholders' meeting that had been scheduled for December 23."
Norfolk Southern is offering to buy Conrail for $10 billion in an all-cash transaction that values Conrail at $110 per share.
CSX and Conrail earlier revised their $8.5 billion cash and stock pact to include an additional $870 million in convertible preferred shares.
Shares of Conrail rose 5/8 to a 52-week high of 99-5/8. CSX shares fell one to 44-1/4 and Norfolk Southern shares gained 1/4 to 86-1/2.
